html:
Did you know that we don’t just tint car windows? We also do residential window tinting. Below we list the reasons why so many Australians are getting residential tinting for their homes and the types of film we use for residential tinting.

Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted tinting network for car, home and office window tinting. We have been providing tinting services in Australia for over 42 years. All films in our range are exclusive to us and are government certified by ARPANSA to ensure the highest quality. Our team of installers are all professionally trained and we offer a lifetime warranty on all residential applications (up to 15 years for commercial applications). Want to know why residential tinting is becoming increasingly popular? Read on!

Reasons Why Residential Tinting Is So Popular

One of the primary reasons people choose to get residential tinting for their homes in Australia is because the films absorb and reflect heat from the sun so your home is much cooler. The film also creates an insulating layer to your windows that helps to keep your home warmer during winter – this also makes your air conditioning and heating more efficient too (which you’ll notice in your power bills).

When it comes to privacy we have a range of darker shades and reflective films that prevent people from seeing into your home during the day whilst still letting in natural light. If you’re not sure about changing the appearance of your home, we have films in lighter shades too.

Our safety and security films are popular too. They are stronger than standard films and because they hold shattered glass together they make it harder for people to break into your home and also help to prevent injury if the glass is broken accidentally or in the event of severe weather.

All films in our range also offer protection from harmful UV rays. Australia has one of the highest rates of skin cancer in the world so knowing that you and your family are protected in your home will give you great peace of mind. Your floorings and furnishings will also be protected from premature fading.

To find out the features and benefits of each of our residential tinting options, here are the films in our range:

  • Solar window films
  • Privacy films
  • Safety films
  • Security films
  • Decorative films

Find Residential Window Tinting Near Me

Use our Store Finder to find residential window tinting near me. Your local window tinting experts will be able to give you residential window tinting costs and answer any questions you have regarding residential tinting.

When asking about residential window tinting costs, ask about our zero-interest payment plans with Afterpay and Zip Pay.
